label: Isotope Ratio Mass Spectrometer (IRMS)
description: A precision instrument that ionizes gas samples to measure the relative abundance of stable isotopes.

components.function: Turns the sample into a plasma.
Bends the ion path based on atomic mass.
Detects and counts the ions hitting the back of the machine.

game_mechanics.calibration_check: Player must run a 'Standard' (known sample) before the fossil to ensure the machine isn't drifting.
game_mechanics.power_drain: Running this machine uses significant 'Base Power'—don't run it at the same time as the Industrial Abrasive Cabinet!
